segments.text: Welcome to nexus.
It's the online home for all extension paperwork.
Extension means training and outreach projects run with outside communities.
One record follows proposal, agreement, delivery.
First, the people: a proponent owns the proposal, evaluators review it, coordinators endorse it.
An MOA is the signed partnership agreement, and a tracker shows each document's stage.
Seven roles use nexus, and each one lands on a dashboard built for its work.
Next, see exactly what each role can do.
Faculty create proposals, answer reviewer comments, run the activity, and file its reports.
Office staff see every proposal, move agreements along, and request quarterly reports.
Evaluators work a review queue, comment on exact sections, and return or approve proposals.
Department coordinators endorse their department's proposals and file its quarterly reports.
Campus coordinators route work across departments and monitor all campus proposals.
The Director assigns evaluators, gives final approval, and watches the office's targets.
Admins run the system — accounts, website, templates, security — but never your proposal.
After signing in, your dashboard shows every proposal you own and where each one stands.
Start one with a single click.
Building a proposal means walking through twenty guided sections, one question at a time.
Drafts save automatically, so return anytime and submit when complete.
Reviewers attach comments to the exact section that needs changing, not vague email threads.
Every revision stays on the record as it moves through seven statuses.
When a partner is involved, the MOA tracker carries the agreement through six stages to signing.
No partner? Skip it.
Once approved, the activity runs through six implementation stages, from launch to final documents.
Reports and paperwork come from the same record, ready to print.
The public website is edited without code — admins drag reusable blocks onto pages.
Every change is logged, showing who edited it.
Every account is protected by verified email, auto-logout, login lockouts, and secure cloud storage.
That's nexus — one record, from idea to final document.
Log in and start your first proposal.
